title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the make_merge_log endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users to access POS Invoice data beyond their permitted scope, including customer details, posting dates, and grand totals. The vulnerability does not affect integrity or availability but exposes limited confidential information.
